mapper.select:
with t1 as( SELECT holdShare.PORTFOLIO_ID as portfolioId, pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME as portfolioName, holdShare.FINPROD_ID as finprodId, holdShare.cost, holdShare.amount, holdShare.marketValue, holdShare.interestReceivable, fpt.TYPE_8 as assetTypeOne, fpt.TYPE_9 as assetTypeTwo, fpt.TYPE_10 as assetTypeThree, fpt.TYPE_11 as assetTypeFour, fpt.TYPE_12 as assetTypeFive, fp.FINPROD_NAME as finprodName, fp.FINPROD_TYPE as finprodType, fp.ISSUER, fp.FINANCIER, fp.MANAGER, fp.SPONSOR, fp.INVEST_ADVISER as investAdviser, fpt.UPDATE_TIME FROM (SELECT min(PORTFOLIO_ID) as PORTFOLIO_ID, --组合代码 FINPROD_ID, --金融产品代码 SUM(DSC_COST_AMT) as cost, --摊销总成本 直接投资成本 SUM(SHARE_AMT) as amount, --数量 直接投资数量 decode(SUM(DSC_COST_AMT),null,SUM(TDY_FLOAT_INGPL),decode(SUM(TDY_FLOAT_INGPL),null,SUM(DSC_COST_AMT),SUM(DSC_COST_AMT+TDY_FLOAT_INGPL))) as marketValue, --摊销总成本+公允价值变动 直接投资市值 SUM(TDY_INTINCEXP) as interestReceivable --当日应计利息 直接投资应收利息 FROM PTL_SEC_VALUTION WHERE 1=1
AND CDATE = to_date(#{sysDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-MM-dd')
GROUP BY FINPROD_ID )holdShare --持仓表.组合代码 = 组合.组合代码 JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO pp ON holdShare.PORTFOLIO_ID = pp.PORTFOLIO_ID --标的类金融产品表 ON 持仓表.金融产品代码 = 标的类金融产品表.金融产品代码 JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp ON holdShare.FINPROD_ID = fp.FINPROD_ID --持仓表.金融产品代码 = 金融产品分类表.金融产品代码 JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt ON holdShare.FINPROD_ID = fpt.FINPROD_ID WHERE 1=1
--发行人 AND (fp.ISSUER = #{agencyId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} --融资人 OR fp.FINANCIER = #{agencyId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} --管理人 OR fp.MANAGER = #{agencyId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} --担保人 OR fp.SPONSOR = #{agencyId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} --投资顾问 OR fp.INVEST_ADVISER = #{agencyId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
),t2 as ( SELECT holdShare.PORTFOLIO_ID as portfolioId, pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME as portfolioName, holdShare.FINPROD_ID as finprodId, holdShare.cost, holdShare.amount, holdShare.marketValue, holdShare.interestReceivable, fpt.TYPE_8 as assetTypeOne, fpt.TYPE_9 as assetTypeTwo, fpt.TYPE_10 as assetTypeThree, fpt.TYPE_11 as assetTypeFour, fpt.TYPE_12 as assetTypeFive, fp.FINPROD_NAME as finprodName, fp.FINPROD_TYPE as finprodType, fp.ISSUER, fp.FINANCIER, fp.MANAGER, fp.SPONSOR, fp.INVEST_ADVISER as investAdviser FROM (SELECT min(PORTFOLIO_ID) as PORTFOLIO_ID, --组合代码 FINPROD_ID, --金融产品代码 SUM(DSC_COST_AMT) as cost, --摊销总成本 直接投资成本 SUM(SHARE_AMT) as amount, --数量 直接投资数量 SUM(DSC_COST_AMT) as marketValue, --摊销总成本+公允价值变动 直接投资市值 SUM(TDY_INTINCEXP) as interestReceivable --当日应计利息 直接投资应收利息 FROM PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION WHERE 1=1
AND CDATE = to_date(#{sysDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-MM-dd')
GROUP BY FINPROD_ID )holdShare --持仓表.组合代码 = 组合.组合代码 JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO pp ON holdShare.PORTFOLIO_ID = pp.PORTFOLIO_ID --标的类金融产品表 ON 持仓表.金融产品代码 = 标的类金融产品表.金融产品代码 JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp ON holdShare.FINPROD_ID = fp.FINPROD_ID --持仓表.金融产品代码 = 金融产品分类表.金融产品代码 JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt ON holdShare.FINPROD_ID = fpt.FINPROD_ID WHERE 1=1
--发行人 and( fp.ISSUER = #{agencyId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} --融资人 OR fp.FINANCIER = #{agencyId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} --管理人 OR fp.MANAGER = #{agencyId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} --担保人 OR fp.SPONSOR = #{agencyId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} --投资顾问 OR fp.INVEST_ADVISER = #{agencyId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
) SELECT ROWNUM as seqNo, decode(a.ISSUER,null,a.ISSUER2,a.ISSUER) ISSUER, decode(a.FINANCIER,null,a.FINANCIER2,a.FINANCIER) FINANCIER, decode(a.MANAGER,null,a.MANAGER2,a.MANAGER) MANAGER, decode(a.SPONSOR,null,a.SPONSOR2,a.SPONSOR) SPONSOR, decode(a.investAdviser,null,a.investAdviser2,a.investAdviser) investAdviser, a.portfolioId, a.portfolioName, a.assetTypeOne, a.assetTypeTwo, a.assetTypeThree, a.assetTypeFour, a.assetTypeFive, a.assetId, a.assetName, a.assetType, a.amount, a.marketValue, a.cost, a.interestReceivable, decode(a.marketValue,'-',a.interestReceivable,decode(a.interestReceivable,'-',a.marketValue,a.marketValue+a.interestReceivable)) positionAll, a.diAmount, a.diMarketValue, a.diCost, a.diInterestReceivable, a.iiAmount, a.iiMarketValue, a.iiCost, a.iiInterestReceivable FROM (SELECT decode(t1.ISSUER,nvl(#{agencyId},0),t1.ISSUER,null) ISSUER, decode(t1.FINANCIER,nvl(#{agencyId},0),t1.FINANCIER,null) FINANCIER, decode(t1.MANAGER,nvl(#{agencyId},0),t1.MANAGER,null) MANAGER, decode(t1.SPONSOR,nvl(#{agencyId},0),t1.SPONSOR,null) SPONSOR, decode(t1.investAdviser,nvl(#{agencyId},0),t1.investAdviser,null) investAdviser,
decode(t2.ISSUER,nvl(#{agencyId},0),t2.ISSUER,null) ISSUER2, decode(t2.FINANCIER,nvl(#{agencyId},0),t2.FINANCIER,null) FINANCIER2, decode(t2.MANAGER,nvl(#{agencyId},0),t2.MANAGER,null) MANAGER2, decode(t2.SPONSOR,nvl(#{agencyId},0),t2.SPONSOR,null) SPONSOR2, decode(t2.investAdviser,nvl(#{agencyId},0),t2.investAdviser,null) investAdviser2, t1.portfolioId, t1.portfolioName, t1.assetTypeOne, t1.assetTypeTwo, t1.assetTypeThree, t1.assetTypeFour, t1.assetTypeFive, t1.finprodId as assetId, t1.finprodName as assetName, t1.finprodType as assetType, decode(t1.amount,null,decode(t2.amount,null,'-',t2.amount),decode(t2.amount,null,t1.amount,t1.amount+t2.amount)) amount, decode(t1.marketValue,null,decode(t2.marketValue,null,'-',t2.marketValue),decode(t2.marketValue,null,t1.marketValue,t1.marketValue+t2.marketValue)) marketValue, decode(t1.cost,null,decode(t2.cost,null,'-',t2.cost),decode(t2.cost,null,t1.cost,t1.cost+t2.cost)) cost, decode(t1.interestReceivable,null,decode(t2.interestReceivable,null,'-',t2.interestReceivable),decode(t2.interestReceivable,null,t1.interestReceivable,t1.interestReceivable+t2.interestReceivable)) interestReceivable, decode(t1.amount,null,'-',t1.amount) as diAmount, decode(t1.marketValue,null,'-',t1.marketValue) as diMarketValue, decode(t1.cost,null,'-',t1.cost) as diCost, decode(t1.interestReceivable,null,'-',t1.interestReceivable) as diInterestReceivable, decode(t2.amount,null,'-',t2.amount) as iiAmount, decode(t2.marketValue,null,'-',t2.marketValue) as iiMarketValue, decode(t2.cost,null,'-',t2.cost) as iiCost, decode(t2.interestReceivable,null,'-',t2.interestReceivable) as iiInterestReceivable FROM t1 LEFT JOIN t2 on t1.portfolioId = t2.portfolioId and t1.finprodId = t2.finprodId ORDER BY t1.UPDATE_TIME DESC)a

SELECT DISTINCT res.id, decode(mci.customer_name,null,res.id,mci.customer_name) text FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT fp.ISSUER id FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION psp LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp ON psp.finprod_id = fp.finprod_id WHERE fp.ISSUER IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT DISTINCT fp.FINANCIER id FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION psp LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp ON psp.finprod_id = fp.finprod_id WHERE fp.FINANCIER IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT DISTINCT fp.MANAGER id FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION psp LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp ON psp.finprod_id = fp.finprod_id WHERE fp.MANAGER IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT DISTINCT fp.SPONSOR id FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION psp LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp ON psp.finprod_id = fp.finprod_id WHERE fp.SPONSOR IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT DISTINCT fp.INVEST_ADVISER id FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION psp LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp ON psp.finprod_id = fp.finprod_id WHERE fp.INVEST_ADVISER IS NOT NULL )res LEFT JOIN MST_CUSTOMER_INFO mci on res.id = mci.customer_id
AND (res.id like concat(concat('%', #{agencyId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%') OR mci.customer_name like concat(concat('%', #{agencyId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%'))
ORDER BY res.id

SELECT a.seqno, a.corOrgtype corOrgtype, a.corClass, a.pId, a.pName, a.id, a.name, b.ORG_NO AS agencyId FROM (SELECT ioc.seqno seqNo, ioc.cor_class corClass, ioc.COR_ORGTYPE AS corOrgtype, ioc.ORG_NO AS pId, mci2.customer_name AS pName, ioc.COR_ORGID AS id, nvl(mci.CUSTOMER_NAME, ioc.EXECUTIVE_NAME || '(' || ioc.TITLE || ')') AS name FROM INF_ORG_CORRELATION ioc LEFT JOIN MST_CUSTOMER_INFO mci ON ioc.cor_orgid = mci.customer_id LEFT JOIN MST_CUSTOMER_INFO mci2 ON ioc.ORG_NO = mci2.customer_id)a LEFT JOIN (SELECT ORG_NO FROM INF_ORG_CORRELATION GROUP BY ORG_NO) b on a.id = b.ORG_NO
AND a.pId = #{agencyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM INF_ORG_CORRELATION WHERE SEQNO = #{seqNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
